items.headline: $NEAR Pumps 32% as Tokenization Tokens Lead Rally
items.summary: $NEAR surged 32% while $STRK and $ARB added 27% and 26%, leading a broad altcoin rally as Bitcoin touched $81K. Tokenization-themed tokens are the day's hottest sector.

items.headline: $POL Set for 100M Token Permissionless Burn
items.summary: Polygon is preparing a permissionless burn of 100 million $POL, with contracts on testnet awaiting final signatures. Quarterly base-fee burns will later become community-callable.

items.headline: $NUSD Depegs to $0.51, Junior Tranche Faces Wipeout
items.summary: Neutrl opened $NUSD redemptions at just 51 cents while Strata's junior tranche faces a full write-down to zero. Senior tranche withdrawals settle in $sNUSD at revised values.

items.headline: NYSE Spent a Year Testing $AVAX for Tokenization
items.summary: Ava Labs' president revealed the NYSE spent a year testing $AVAX tech for its tokenization plans, working closely with exchange parent ICE. No final selection confirmed yet.

items.headline: Arc Launches AI Agent That Builds Onchain Apps
items.summary: Arc unveiled Arc Studio, an AI coding agent that generates onchain apps and smart contracts from simple prompts. The tool could lower the barrier for launching new DeFi protocols.
